name: Ananda Sangha Kolkata
reason: Too thin and stale: the events calendar has no upcoming events (latest January 2026); the home page's Learn to Meditate batches are August 2026 with no price; Ananda Yoga and satsang pages give no schedule or price. Real address (18/31 Dover Lane) and email kolkata@anandaindia.org exist, so worth a recheck. Note: Asha Nayaswami (on Spiritpedia) appears only as a 2014 visiting lecturer (videos), not as a teacher there.
